origin.description: Returns a ColorBrewer palette as hex colors.

arguments.name: n
arguments.text: Number of colors. The smallest palette has 3, and the largest depends on the name.

arguments.name: name
arguments.text: A sequential, diverging, or qualitative ColorBrewer palette name.

origin.details: A count below 3 warns and returns the 3-color palette. A count above that palette's maximum warns and returns the longest palette. Any other name is an error. Sequential palettes have 3 to 9 colors, diverging palettes have 3 to 11, and qualitative palettes stop at 8, 9, or 12.

translation.description: Returns a ColorBrewer palette as hex colors.

arguments.name: n
arguments.text: Number of colors. A value below 3 or above the palette maximum warns and returns that boundary palette. At or above 3, a non-integer selects trunc(n).

translation.details: The colors are the grDevices::rgb hex strings of the integer channels in R/ColorBrewer.R, with maxColorValue 255. switch(n - 2) truncates toward zero, so 3.9 is the 3-color palette.
